thread:
Marta: RC-2026-04 ready for origination. Artifact: sha:7c9d1f4. Need QA sign-off and a pin for the candidate.
Samira: Good — what's the quiet window and promo slot?
Marta: Quiet window 22:00-23:00 UTC tonight. Promo slot 22:30 UTC. Planning to pin rc to sha:7c9d1f4 across regions.
Patrick: QA smoke passed on staging. Ran quick eval suite — 12/12 pass, two flaky ranking tests flagged (non-blocking). Logs: http://ci/runs/445
QA-Jen: I confirm smoke. No perf regressions observed; p95/p99 stable in staging.
Charlie: Ops checklist: canary 5% for 10m, then 25% for 15m, then 100% if green. KV warm job queued to run at T-10m.
Marta: Release notes draft below — please ack and add any callouts.
Samira: ack from Product. Callout: model tokenization change may affect templating; add upgrade snippet to notes.
Patrick: Also adding migration note for embeddings index (old index stays read-only for 24h).
Marta: Issuing pin now to avoid last-minute surprises.
deploy-bot: /pin rc-2026-04 sha:7c9d1f4
deploy-bot: Pin successful: rc-2026-04 -> sha:7c9d1f4
Marta: Assigning sheriff for the promo window: Charlie on-deck, Samira backup.
Charlie: On it. Monitoring latency, error budget, and token cost delta during canary. Alert thresholds set in the runbook.
Patrick: Quick rollback criteria we agreed: error rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 50% for 5m -> rollback to rc-2026-03 (sha:a2b4c3d).
Samira: Who executes rollback? Ops or deploy-bot auto-rollback?
Charlie: I'll execute manual rollback via deploy-bot unless auto-roll is triggered by SRE policy.
Marta: Final confirmations — green?
Samira: green
Patrick: green
QA-Jen: green
Charlie: green
Marta: Final deploy command we'll run (staged canary -> prod):
```
deploybot promote --rc rc-2026-04 --pin sha:7c9d1f4 --canary 5 --region global
```
Marta: If canary is healthy, we'll step to 25% at +10m then +100% at +25m. I'll post precise timestamps when I trigger.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary promotion for 2023-11-15T22:30:00Z (internal clock corrected)
Marta: Thanks team — I'll trigger at T-5 and post live promote time and watchlist. Will update with rollout readout after 30m.
Charlie: I'll keep the emergency rollback command ready and notify on-call if thresholds hit.
Marta: Release notes (draft):
- RC-2026-04: model runtime and tokenization fixes
- Pin: sha:7c9d1f4 (ensures deterministic artifacts)
- Known issues: two flaky ranking tests in CI (non-blocking), embeddings index migration in read-only mode for 24h
- Rollback target: rc-2026-03 (sha:a2b4c3d)
Please add anything else before I publish to release-notes.
Samira: Looks good, I'll add the product-facing blurb and send to marketing after promo.
Marta: End of thread — will post final promote time shortly.
